checks: Automatically resumes the same launch after HTML, malformed JSON or network error and navigates once, with one launch POST.
Build progress recovers to its original share link without resubmission.
Three retries at1/2/4s after an initial failure, then manual progress control; manual retry reads the same ID.
HTTP401/403/404/429 do not trigger automatic retries.
Each status read times out at10s; a successful read resets the consecutive failure count.
Obsolete ready responses after stop, changed build selection or pagehide cannot change the view, schedule recovery or open a product.
Launch creation is never automatically repeated and history failure cannot undo product readiness.

scope: Execute the real browser client source in a deterministic minimal DOM with controlled network and clock. Full local/Linux suites plus a separate real-browser loopback reproduction/acceptance. Production status GET retries only; no automated resubmission of creation, writes, authorization or stop.
